patterns.note: A full-bleed hero image dominates the initial viewport, followed by a two-column grid of large, image-centric product features that maintain generous white space.
Exclusive use of a clean, uppercase sans-serif for primary navigation and branding, contrasted with a slightly softer sans-serif for product details and body text.
A strictly monochromatic palette of black and white, with natural, muted tones derived from photography, creating a sophisticated, understated feel.
The hero image scrolls at a slower rate than the page content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect, while the main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport.
Content is organized into distinct, image-dominant blocks with minimal text, resembling editorial spreads rather than typical e-commerce product listings.

technique_notes: The hero image is implemented with a subtle parallax effect, where its vertical position shifts slower than the user's scroll, creating a sense of depth. The main navigation bar is designed to stick to the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero section, maintaining accessibility. This motion is likely achieved using CSS transforms or background-position animations triggered by scroll events, possibly leveraging css-keyframes.

The site employs a high-contrast, monochromatic visual style, using black text on a white background, with all visual interest derived from large, high-quality, often black-and-white or desaturated photography.

A single sans-serif font family is used consistently, with uppercase styling for navigation and brand elements, and varying weights and sizes to establish a clear content hierarchy without introducing additional typefaces.

design_tokens.type_scale: Prominent, clean sans-serif headings (product titles) are moderately larger (~2x body), with very small, uppercase navigation and footer text (~0.7x body).
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous white space is used around images and between content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and calm.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its highly editorial and minimalist approach, heavily relying on large, high-quality, often monochromatic photography to convey a sense of luxury and brand identity. It feels more like a curated fashion magazine spread than a typical e-commerce interface, prioritizing aesthetic experience over dense product information.
